title: People’s Mañanera October 15
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Mexico Grows at Twice the OECD Average with Shared Prosperity  
** The Mexican economy grew 1.4%, double the OECD average (0.7%), and its
growth ranked seventh worldwide. President Claudia Sheinbaum highlighted
investment in housing and infrastructure and expressed her desire to be
remembered as “a good president who did everything for the well-being of the
people.”

**“Neoliberalism is over in Mexico; it won’t return”: Sheinbaum  
** According to the Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean
(ECLAC), Mexico accounted for 60% of the reduction in poverty in Latin America
between 2014 and 2024. The President contrasted 36 years of neoliberalism and
concentration of wealth with “Mexican Humanism,” based on higher wages, public
investment, and the well-being of the people.

**Mexico Is in Vogue: Record Tourism with Benefits for Communities  
** From January to August, 67.7 million international travelers arrived in
Mexico (+6.3%), and spent more than US$24.15 billion. Sheinbaum emphasized
that the growth in tourism must translate into more income for artisans,
businesspeople, and communities—not just for large corporations.

**Jalisco: Investigate Repression and Guarantee Clean Water  
** The National Human Rights Commission (CNDH) is investigating allegations of
repression against protesters in Guadalajara. Sheinbaum reiterated that police
abuses must be punished and announced that the National Water Commission
(Conagua) is working on solutions to the problems of the supply and quality of
drinking water. This includes a technical review and a subsequent dialogue
with the Jalisco state government.
